scope: Same remote gfx1151 host and identical Q4 target/Q4 draft GGUF files, after stopping the desktop crash-reporter loop. C1 raw JSON/prose TG300. These are K-quant controls, not a reproduction of the FP4 headline or an independent model-quality qualification.

method.warmup: 32 JSON tokens before every engine/policy arm; excluded. No builds or other model jobs during timings.
method.host_cleanup: Stopped user drkonqi-coredump-launcher.socket for the run; no persistent disable/mask or power/clock change. Failed reporter instances date back to 2026-09-12 15:02:07CEST. Earlier comparison timings are excluded; only quiet/ results are used.
method.repetitions: One AR sample per prompt/engine; two adaptive samples per prompt/engine; two fixed-7 JSON samples per engine.
method.ordering_limit: Sequential exploratory controls, not interleaved ABBA or a variance study. Preserve individual samples.
method.gufo_timing: Release prompt command's Generate duration: includes prefill, excludes loading and final token hashing.
method.upstream_timing: 300 / ((prompt_ms + predicted_ms) / 1000). Also retain API decode-only rate and HTTP wall duration. API decode-only timing counts 299 post-anchor tokens.
method.upstream_lifecycle: One owned localhost server per policy arm, C1, context4096; repeated requests on its slot, cache_prompt=false and cache_n=0. Gufo prompt starts a new process per sample.
method.upstream_controller_reset: Pinned common/speculative.cpp:reset_acc_ema is called by DFlash begin; state resets for a new request.

quality.gufo: Both fresh AR runs match the saved qualified token hashes. All six measured speculative continuations match all 300 AR IDs, and repeat hashes/acceptance counts agree.
quality.upstream_json: All four measured speculative continuations match all 300 upstream and Gufo AR IDs.
quality.fixed7_control: Both engines draft302/accept255, with 44 verification rounds, on identical emitted JSON IDs. The throughput gap persists with adaptive control removed.
quality.interpretation: These checks test exact AR and repeat equivalence. Divergence does not establish a semantic quality regression, identify a controller defect, or make either implementation ground truth.
quality.not_run: No 75-question capability suite, full depth matrix, new full-logit sweep, original-checkpoint qualification, or upstream prose root-cause trace.

small_batch_profile.method: Upstream llama-bench -p4,8 -n0 -b2048 -ub512 -ngl99 -fa1 -r2 --no-warmup. GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER=1, frequency1000000. Operator timings only, not throughput qualification.
small_batch_profile.limit: Synthetic small prefill exercises width4/8 projections, but only the final row's output head. It is not a complete speculative verification or draft profile and is not paired with Gufo microbenchmarks.
small_batch_profile.server_profile_failure: Upstream server profiler aborts in common_context_can_seq_rm at ggml-vulkan.cpp:17966, asserting compute_ctx.expired(), before readiness. Same result with async disabled. No speed or quality results from either attempt.
small_batch_profile.finding: Matrix projections dominate both small batches. Reuse of block decoding across tokens is already implemented in Gufo; the next investigation needs an identified remaining projection bottleneck, not a wholesale copy of the FP4 path.

source_review.finding: Adaptive length uses prior accepted-token EMA, alpha 0.25 and additive upward probing after full acceptance. DFlash2 chooses the block before greedy selector proposals. It does not relax target verification.
Normal greedy verification samples the target at each row and continues only while its token equals the draft. Published headline command contains no synthetic acceptance option.

Checkpoint replay trusts tokens verified before restore; its comment acknowledges batch-shape-dependent logits. This is a reason to qualify scalar/batched parity, not evidence that the headline used this branch or emitted incorrect tokens.
Probe returns response timings only; logs contain throughput, counts and acceptance, but no output tokens or AR/speculative equality checks. This does not establish lossless target equivalence.
Reported FP4 gains include batched matvec/dequantization tuning for widths 3-8. These concern different weight formats and numerics; their quality cannot be assumed identical to Gufo K-quants.

limits: The FP4 headline (~65.6 JSON /26.1 prose decode tok/s) remains unreached. This faster same-artifact K-quant control does not fulfill that separate performance goal.
Headline target/draft files, historical build, driver and host settings are not reproduced; no claim that the author's published measurements are incorrect.
Same prompt and target weights do not imply the same continuation. Consult the per-run hashes and explicit AR/repeat checks; prose throughput is not a comparison on identical token continuations.
No causal attribution of the entire speed gap to verification kernels; draft execution, state handling, kernels and frontend timing all contribute.
No production code, quantization, sampler or verification policy changed in this comparison.
excluded_runs: First-pass /tmp/qwen-laurent-compare/*.json and /tmp/qwen-laurent-target-profile.* overlapped a desktop crash-reporter loop. Their token checks remain valid, but their timings are not used here. The upstream server-profiler attempts failed before readiness.
